items.question: Had I studied very well, I _____ rewarded with a vacation in the U.S.

rationalization.A: Incorrect. 'Was' does not form the required past counterfactual result.
rationalization.B: Correct. 'Would have been rewarded' matches an unfulfilled past condition.
rationalization.C: Incorrect. 'Will be' is future, not past counterfactual.
rationalization.D: Incorrect. 'Would be' is not the appropriate third-conditional result form.

items.explanation: In an inverted third conditional, 'Had I studied' means 'If I had studied.' The result clause takes 'would have been rewarded.'

items.question: When helping in the kitchen, I am always careful not to hurt _____

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Ourselves' is a plural reflexive pronoun and does not agree with the singular subject 'I'.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. 'Myself' is the first-person singular reflexive pronoun that correctly corresponds to the subject pronoun 'I'.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Herself' is a third-person feminine singular reflexive pronoun and lacks antecedent agreement with 'I'.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Himself' is a third-person masculine singular reflexive pronoun and does not match the subject 'I'.

items.explanation: Reflexive pronouns are used when the subject and the object of the verb refer to the exact same person or thing. The subject 'I' requires the matching first-person singular reflexive pronoun 'myself'.
items.memoryTip: Subject-Reflexive Agreement: I â†’ MYSELF; We â†’ OURSELVES.

items.question: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present at the affair.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Were' is past tense, whereas 'are' is the designated present-tense agreement choice following proximity rules.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees in number with the closer subject ('students', which is plural, taking 'are').
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Was' is a singular past verb and violates agreement with the closer plural subject 'students'.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Is' is a singular present verb and disagrees with the closer subject 'students'.

items.explanation: According to the Rule of Proximity for compound subjects joined by 'correlative conjunctions' (either...or, neither...nor), the verb must agree in number with the subject noun located closest to the verb.
items.memoryTip: Rule of Proximity (Either/Or, Neither/Nor): Verb agrees with the subject CLOSER to it.
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Subject-Verb Agreement

items.question: My sister and I met an acquaintance of ______ at the shopping mall.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Ourselves' is reflexive and cannot function as the object in a double possessive structure.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. 'Us' is an objective pronoun; 'acquaintance of us' is non-idiomatic compared to the double possessive 'of ours'.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. The construction 'an acquaintance of ours' uses a double possessive (preposition 'of' + possessive pronoun 'ours') to indicate one among our acquaintances.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Mine' excludes the 'sister' who is part of the compound subject ('My sister and I').

items.explanation: A double possessive (or double genitive) occurs when possession is shown using both the preposition 'of' and an absolute possessive pronoun (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs). 'An acquaintance of ours' means 'one of our acquaintances'.
items.memoryTip: Double Possessive Pattern: A friend/acquaintance OF OURS (Preposition + Possessive Pronoun).
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Pronoun Cases
items.audit_reason: Corrected the preposition 'on the shopping mall' to idiomatic 'at the shopping mall.'

items.question: We admire _____ when Cynthia speaks English fluently with _____.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Him' is masculine and does not refer to Cynthia; 'them' changes the plural first-person context established by 'we'.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. 'Ours' is a possessive pronoun, but the preposition 'with' requires an objective case pronoun ('us').
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Both blanks require object pronouns: 'her' receives the action of 'admire' (referring to Cynthia), and 'us' serves as the object of the preposition 'with'.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Him' is masculine, and 'we' is a nominative/subject pronoun rather than an objective pronoun.

items.explanation: Pronouns functioning as direct objects or objects of prepositions must be in the objective case (me, you, him, her, it, us, them). 'Her' is the direct object of 'admire' (referring to Cynthia), and 'us' is the object of the preposition 'with'.
items.memoryTip: Prepositions and Direct Objects take Objective Pronouns (her, us, him, them).
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Pronoun Cases

rationalization.B: Correct. 'Me' is the objective pronoun required after 'to.'
rationalization.C: Incorrect. 'Myself' is reflexive and is not required here.

items.explanation: After the preposition 'to,' an objective pronoun is required. 'Me' is the objective form corresponding to 'I.'
items.memoryTip: AFTER A PREPOSITION → OBJECTIVE CASE: to ME, with HIM, for US.

items.question: The student's request to re-set the test ____ reasonable.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Were' is plural, but the head noun subject 'request' is singular.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. 'Very' is an intensifier adverb and cannot function as the main linking verb of the predicate.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Are' is a plural verb, disagreeing with the singular head noun 'request'.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. The simple subject is the singular noun 'request' (not 'students' or 'test'), which agrees with the singular linking verb 'is'.

items.explanation: Do not let intervening prepositional phrases ('to re-set the test') confuse subject-verb agreement. The simple subject is 'request', which is singular and takes the singular linking verb 'is'.
items.memoryTip: Ignore intervening prepositional phrases: The REQUEST (singular) â†’ IS reasonable.

items.question: â€œMy concept of inner peace came from my motherâ€™s daily activities which I now recall with fondness and awe. She was a full-time housewife wholly dependent on my fatherâ€™s monthly salary. How she made both ends meet, guided us in our students and did small acts of charity on the side was beyond me.â€ based on the recount, the motherâ€™s financial resource were ______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'More than enough' contradicts the phrase 'made both ends meet', which signifies tight budgeting.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. 'Abundant' implies wealth, contradicting dependence on a single salary and strict budgeting.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Enough' fails to capture the strain and constraint implied by struggling to make ends meet.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. The idiom 'made both ends meet' and 'wholly dependent on my father's monthly salary' directly indicate that funds were strictly limited.

items.explanation: Context clues in reading comprehension provide meaning. The idiom 'made both ends meet' means earning just enough money to live on and cover expenses, directly implying that the financial resources were limited.

items.question: â€œThe figures must be TRANSMUTED in order to understand the grade.â€ The capitalized word means _______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Estimated' means approximated, not systematically converted or converted in form.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. 'Transmuted' means changed, transformed, or converted from one form, nature, or value to another (e.g., converting raw scores to grades).
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Surpassed' means exceeded or went beyond.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Summed' means added together, which is only an initial step before grade transmutation.

items.explanation: Transmute means to change or alter in form, appearance, or nature. In grading systems, raw score figures are transmuted (changed/converted) into equivalent academic marks using a transmutation table.
items.memoryTip: TRANSMUTE = Convert or CHANGE form/value (Transmutation Table).

items.question: Some preachers suggest the ____ that the end of the world is near.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Proposal' refers to a plan or suggestion, whereas predicting the end of the world is a religious prediction.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. 'Prophetic' is an adjective and cannot serve as the noun object following the article 'the'.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. 'Prophecy' is the noun meaning a prediction of future events made under divine inspiration.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Prophet' refers to the person who predicts, whereas the blank requires the prediction itself.

items.explanation: Syntax requires a noun following the definite article 'the'. A 'prophecy' is a divinely inspired prediction or declaration of what is to come. A 'prophet' is the person who utters a prophecy.
items.memoryTip: PROPHECY = The prediction (Noun); PROPHET = The person (Noun); PROPHETIC = Descriptive (Adjective).
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Vocabulary and Word Choice

items.question: The courage of the child who saved his brother from a raging fire is worth ____.

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. 'Emulating' means imitating or striving to equal an admirable deed or heroic quality.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. 'Mentoring' means advising or guiding, which does not fit the context of praising heroic bravery.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Narrating' means recounting a story, which does not reflect the moral value of heroism.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Watching' means passively observing, which falls short of honoring brave conduct.

items.explanation: Emulate means to match or surpass a person or achievement, typically by imitation. Noble traits like courage and altruism are worth emulating (imitating as a good example).
items.memoryTip: EMULATE = Imitate or copy a good example or virtue.

items.question: The expression of â€œbaduyâ€ connotes:

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Baduy' refers to style and appearance rather than level of formal schooling.

items.question: Several factors must be assessed to arrive at a sound _____.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Query' means a question, which is raised before assessment rather than arrived at after.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Collocationally, one assesses factors to arrive at a 'sound decision' (a wise and well-founded choice).
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Change' does not pair idiomatically with 'sound' in logical decision-making contexts.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Problem' is an issue to be solved, not the logical outcome of evaluating factors.

items.explanation: In English collocations, the adjective 'sound' means reliable, sensible, or showing good judgment. A 'sound decision' is a well-considered conclusion formed after assessing relevant factors.
items.memoryTip: Collocation: Arrive at a SOUND DECISION (wise choice).

items.question: â€œBecause of PROFANITY the program was suspended from television.â€ The capitalized word means?

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. 'Profanity' refers to vulgar, sacrilegious, or obscene language/behavior, synonymous with obscenity.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. 'History' refers to past records and has no relation to vulgar broadcast violations.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Decency' means propriety and modesty, which is the antonym of profanity.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Falsehood' means untruthfulness or lying, not vulgarity.

items.explanation: Profanity refers to blasphemous, irreverent, or vulgar language and behavior. Broadcast regulators suspend shows for profanity (obscenity) to maintain public decency standards.
items.memoryTip: PROFANITY = Obscene or vulgar speech/behavior (OBSCENITY).

items.question: A story put together through an exchange of letters is called _____ literature.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. 'Fiction' is a broad genre of invented prose, not specifically letter-based writing.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. An 'epistolary' novel or piece of literature is written in the form of a series of letters or documents (e.g., Urbana at Felisa).
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. 'Episodic' describes a narrative loosely connected by separate episodes.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Classic' refers to recognized literary endurance, not structural format.

items.explanation: An epistolary novel is a novel written as a series of documents or letters (epistles). Famous examples include Bram Stoker's Dracula and the Tagalog classic Urbana at Felisa.
items.memoryTip: EPISTOLARY Literature = Narrative told through LETTERS (Epistles).
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Literary Forms

items.question: What figure of speech is: â€œThe Lord is my shepherd.â€

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. A simile requires explicit comparison words such as 'like' or 'as'.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Hyperbole involves intentional exaggeration for dramatic effect.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Irony expresses meaning by using language that normally signifies the opposite.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. 'The Lord is my shepherd' is a direct metaphor that equates God to a protective shepherd without using 'like' or 'as'.

items.explanation: A metaphor asserts that one thing is another thing for symbolic effect. Equating the Lord directly to a shepherd without comparative conjunctions ('like' or 'as') makes it a classic biblical metaphor.
items.memoryTip: Direct equality comparison without 'like/as' = METAPHOR.
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Figures of Speech

items.question: What figure of speech is: â€œHe is the black sheep of the family.â€

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. Describing a person directly as a 'black sheep' without 'like' or 'as' is a metaphor.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Similes require explicit comparative conjunctions ('like' or 'as').
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Alliteration is the repetition of initial consonant sounds.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Hyperbole is extreme exaggeration.

items.explanation: Calling a family member 'the black sheep' directly identifies the person with an odd or disreputable member of a group without using 'like' or 'as', making it a metaphor.
items.memoryTip: BLACK SHEEP of the family = METAPHOR for a disreputable member.
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Figures of Speech

items.question: â€œSturdy and strong, the Filipinos are like the molave.â€ is ______.

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. The comparison explicitly uses the word 'like' ('like the molave'), making it a simile.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Irony states the opposite of literal meaning.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. A metaphor states direct equivalence without 'like' or 'as'.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Hyperbole is intentional exaggeration.

items.explanation: A simile explicitly compares two different things using comparative words such as 'like' or 'as'. Famous from Rafael Zulueta da Costa's poem Like the Molave, comparing Filipinos to the resilient molave tree using 'like' makes it a simile.
items.memoryTip: Comparison using 'LIKE' or 'AS' = SIMILE.
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Figures of Speech

items.question: â€œShe is a lovely rose.â€ is _______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. It does not use 'like' or 'as'.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. It is a direct poetic comparison, not an extravagant exaggeration.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. It is a complementary figure, not an ironic statement.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Equating 'she' directly to 'a lovely rose' is an implied direct comparison (metaphor).

items.explanation: A metaphor compares two unrelated things by asserting that one IS the other. Stating 'She IS a lovely rose' without 'like' or 'as' is a metaphor.
items.memoryTip: Direct identification ('She IS a rose') = METAPHOR.
items.reference: LET General Education English Reviewer - Figures of Speech

items.question: â€œâ€¦ it droppeth as a gentle rain from heaven.â€ is what figure of speech?

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. It compares the falling of mercy to rain using 'as', rather than giving human attributes.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. The phrase compares mercy to gentle rain using the comparative word 'as' ('droppeth as a gentle rain'), which defines a simile.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. It is a gentle poetic analogy, not an exaggeration.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Metaphor compares directly without 'as' or 'like'.

items.explanation: In Shakespeare's The Merchant of Venice, Portia describes mercy using the word 'as' ('droppeth as the gentle rain from heaven'). Any comparison using 'like' or 'as' is a simile.
items.memoryTip: Droppeth AS a gentle rain = SIMILE (uses 'as').

items.question: In William Shakespeare's *The Merchant of Venice*, Portia says, 'The quality of mercy is not strained; it droppeth as the gentle rain from heaven...' The main thought of the excerpt is that _______.

choices.C: Mercy is spontaneous and freely given

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Portia's speech asserts that mercy blesses both giver and receiver universally.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. The passage describes mercy as divine, powerful, and unconstrained ('not strained').
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. 'Not strained' means mercy cannot be forced or compelled; it flows naturally, spontaneously, and freely like rain from heaven.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Rain is merely a poetic simile for how mercy falls, not its literal source.

items.explanation: In Shakespeare's famous speech, 'not strained' means unforced and unconstrained. Mercy cannot be compelled by law; it is a divine, spontaneous virtue freely bestowed upon others.
items.memoryTip: Quality of mercy is 'not strained' = FREELY GIVEN and spontaneous.

items.question: Though nothing can bring back The hour of splendor in the glass, Of glory in the flower We will grieve not, Rather find strength in what remains behind. This stanza expresses _______.

rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. 'Despair' is the complete opposite of finding strength in what remains.

items.explanation: In William Wordsworth's poem, the speaker resolves not to mourn past youth or glory, but rather to look forward with hope and find inner strength in what endures.

items.question: Cognitive skills are not easily observable because they are _____.

items.question: Which of the following statements is true about textbook laid on the table?

items.memoryTip: LATHALAIN (Feature Article) = Tunay na pangyayari na isinulat sa KAWILI-WILI o malikhaing paraan.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Pahayagang Pangkampus

items.question: 'Kapapasok pa lang niya sa silid.' Ang pandiwa ng pangungusap ay nasa aspektong _______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Imperpektibo ay nagaganap pa lamang.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Kontimplatibo ay gaganapin pa lamang.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Pangnagdaan ay pangkalahatang kategorya ng perpektibo.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Ang 'kapapasok' ay nasa aspektong Perpektibong Katatapos (kakatapos pa lamang ng kilos bago ang pagsasalita).

items.explanation: Ang aspektong Perpektibong Katatapos ay nabubuo sa pamamagitan ng paglalagay ng unlaping 'ka-' at pag-uulit sa unang pantig ng salitang-ugat. Nagsasaad ito ng kilos na kakatapos pa lamang bago ang pagsasalita.
items.memoryTip: Ka- + Pag-uulit ng unang pantig ng salitang-ugat (Kapapasok) = PERPEKTIBONG KATATAPOS.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Aspekto ng Pandiwa

items.question: Katangian ng mahusay na mananaliksik na marunong tumanggap ng kritisismo para sa ikagaganda ng pananaliksik.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Malikhain ay ang pagiging orihinal sa ideya.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Ang pagiging bukas ang isip (open-minded) ay ang kahandaang tumanggap ng mungkahi, puna, at kritisismo upang mapabuti ang pananaliksik.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Maparaan ay ang paghahanap ng solusyon sa sagabal.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Marunong tumanggi ay ukol sa etika ng oras o badyet.

items.explanation: Ang mananaliksik na may bukas na isipan (open-mindedness) ay handang tumanggap ng mga obserbasyon, babala, at kritisismo mula sa mga eksperto at tagasuri upang lalong maitaas ang kalidad ng pag-aaral.
items.memoryTip: Tumatanggap ng kritisismo at mungkahi = BUKAS ANG ISIP (Open-minded).
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Pananaliksik

items.question: Ibigay ang angkop na damdaming napapaloob sa â€œBakit gabi na ay di pa sya dumarating?â€

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Ang pag-aalala sa gabi ay hindi nagpapahayag ng saya.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Ang pagkapoot ay matinding galit o poot.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Ang pagtatanong nang may pag-aalala sa huling pag-uwi sa gabi ay nagpapahayag ng pangamba o pagkatakot sa masamang nangyari.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Mas nangunguna ang pangamba at pagkatakot kaysa sa galit.

items.explanation: Ang pahayag ay nagpapakita ng matinding pangamba at pag-aalala sa kaligtasan ng isang mahal sa buhay na gabi na ay hindi pa nakauuwi, na nagdudulot ng damdamin ng pagkatakot.
items.memoryTip: Pag-aalala sa late na pag-uwi = PAGKATAKOT / Pangamba.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Pag-unawa sa Binasa

items.question: Sistematikong paglalarawan ng mga datos na estadistika?

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Talahanayan (table) ay maayos na pagsasaayos sa hanay at linya.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Ang grapo (graph) ay visual at sistematikong representasyon ng mga datos na estatistikal (hal. bar graph, line graph).
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Balangkas ay hirarkikal na buod ng paksa.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Mapa ay visual na larawan ng heograpiya.

items.explanation: Ang grapo ay isang visual at sistematikong ilustrasyon ng mga numerikal at estatistikal na datos upang mabilis na makita ang trend, paghahambing, o ugnayan ng mga numero.
items.memoryTip: Sistematikong visual na representasyon ng estatistika = GRAPO.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Visual na Datos
items.topic: Filipino - Pagbasa ng Graph at Talahanayan

items.question: Pag-aaral ng mga tuntunin kung paano inaayos ang mga salita sa loob ng pangungusap.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Semantika ay pag-aaral ng kahulugan ng mga salita.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Sintaks (Syntax) ang sangay ng linggwistika na nag-aaral sa pagbuo at pagsasaayos ng mga salita upang makabuo ng makabuluhang pangungusap.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Pragmatika ay pag-aaral sa kahulugan ng wika sa konteksto.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Ortograpiya ay tuntunin sa tamang pagbaybay at pagbantas.

items.explanation: Ang sintaks (syntax) ay ang larangan sa linggwistika na tumatalakay sa mga tuntunin ng pagsasama-sama at pag-aayos ng mga salita upang makabuo ng mga parirala, sugnay, at pangungusap.
items.memoryTip: SINTAKS (Syntax) = Pagsasaayos ng mga salita sa PANGUNGUSAP.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Linggwistika

items.question: Pangungusap na tumutukoy sa pangyayaring pangkalikasan o pangkapaligiran.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Temporal ay tumutukoy sa panahon o oras (hal. Umaga na).
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Eksistensyal ay tumutukoy sa keberahan o pag-iral (hal. May tao).
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Ang pangungusap na Penomenal ay tumutukoy sa mga kalagayan o pangyayaring pangkalikasan (hal. Umuulan; Lumilindol).
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Modal ay nagsasaad ng kagustuhan o obligasyon.

items.explanation: Ang pangungusap na penomenal ay kabilang sa mga pangungusap na walang paksa na tumutukoy sa mga kaganapan o proseso sa kalikasan o kapaligiran (halimbawa: Umuulan, Bumabaha, Kumukulog).
items.memoryTip: PENOMENAL = Pangyayaring PANGKALIKASAN (hal. Umuulan, Bumabaha).
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Uri ng Pangungusap

items.question: Orihinal: Mother cooked adobo for Kuya Manuel. Salin: Si Nanay ay nagluto ng adobo para kay Kuya Manuel. Ito ay pagsasaling ______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Adaptasyon ay malayang pag-aangkop ng kultura.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Malaya ay hindi nakatali sa orihinal na estraktura.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Idyomatiko ay pagsasalin ng kahulugan ng tambalang salita.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Ang literal na pagsasalin ay sunod-sunod at salita-sa-salita batay sa pangunahing kahulugan at gramatika ng orihinal na pangungusap.

items.explanation: Ang literal na pagsasalin ay ang direktang pagsasalin ng mga salita at estraktura ng orihinal na wika patungo sa target na wika, nang hindi binabago ang literal na ayos ng pangungusap.
items.memoryTip: Salita-sa-salitang pagsasalin ng gramatika = LITERAL na Pagsasalin.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Pagsasaling-wika

items.question: Tumutukoy ito sa bilang ng pantig sa bawat taludtod ng tula.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Talinghaga ay ang paggamit ng tayutay at malalim na salita.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Kariktan ay ang kagandahan ng mga salitang ginamit.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Tugma ay ang pagkakatulad ng tunog sa dulo ng taludtod.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Sukat ang tawag sa bilang ng pantig sa bawat taludtod ng tula.

items.explanation: Ang sukat ay isa sa mga elemento ng tula na tumutukoy sa bilang ng pantig sa bawat taludtod o linya ng tula.
items.memoryTip: Bilang ng pantig = SUKAT ng tula.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Elemento ng Tula

items.question: Sa anong bahagi ng pananaliksik matatagpuan ang mga lugar at babasahing mapagkukunan ng mga literatura at pag-aaral?

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Kabanata V ay ang Lagom, Konklusyon, at Rekomendasyon.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Kabanata IV ay ang Presentasyon at Interpretasyon ng Datos.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Kabanata I ay ang Suliranin at Kaligiran Nito.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Ang Kabanata II ay ang Mga Kaugnay na Literatura at Pag-aaral (Review of Related Literature).

items.explanation: Ang Kabanata II ng pamanahong papel ay naglalaman ng 'Mga Kaugnay na Literatura at Pag-aaral', kung saan inilalahad ang mga aklat, artikulo, at nakaraang pananaliksik na may kaugnayan sa kasalukuyang pag-aaral.
items.memoryTip: Kabanata II = MGA KAUGNAY NA LITERATURA AT PAG-AARAL.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Bahagi ng Pananaliksik

items.question: Ang wastong kahulugan ng: 'The present problem is only a storm in a teacup.'

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Hindi ito nangangahulugang galit.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Ang idyomang 'storm in a teacup' (o 'tempest in a teapot') ay nangangahulugang pagpapalaki sa isang maliit na bagay na wala namang totoong kahalagahan o bale wala.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Walang kaugnayan sa tagumpay.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Walang kaugnayan sa buong pusong damdamin.

items.explanation: Ang idyomang Ingles na 'storm in a teacup' ay ginagamit kapag ang mga tao ay labis na nag-aalala o nagtatalo tungkol sa isang bagay na napakaliit o bale-wala naman sa katunayan.
items.memoryTip: Storm in a teacup = Maliit na usapin na BALE WALA.
items.reference: LET General Education English/Filipino Reviewer - Idioms

items.question: Pinakapayak na anyo ng salita na walang kahalong panlapi.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Gitlapi ay uri ng panlapi.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Ponema ay pinakamaliit na yunit ng tunog.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Salitang-ugat ang tawag sa payak na salita na walang dagdag na panlapi.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Laguhan ay salitang may tatlong panlapi.

items.explanation: Ang salitang-ugat ay ang pinakapayak na anyo ng salita na nagtataglay ng buong kahulugan bago ito dagdagan ng anumang uri ng panlapi.
items.memoryTip: Pinakapayak na salita na walang panlapi = SALITANG-UGAT.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Kayarian ng Salita

items.question: Nagpapahayag ng lebel ng wikang impormal na nalikha at nabuo sa pagsasama-sama ng mga salitang pinaikli o pinahaba.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Kolokyal ay pangaraw-araw na salitang ginagamit sa pakikipag-usap.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Lalawiganin ay mga salitang ginagamit sa isang tiyak na rehiyon.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Pampanitikan ay ang pinakamataas na lebel ng wika na ginagamit sa mga tula at nobela.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Ang balbal (slang) ang pinakamababang lebel ng wika na nalilikha ng mga pangkat sa lipunan sa pamamagitan ng pagpapahaba, pagpapaikli, o pagbaligtad ng mga salita.

items.explanation: Ang wikang balbal (slang) ay itinuturing na pinakamababang antas ng wika. Ito ay binubuo ng mga salitang kanto o kalsada na nabuo sa pamamagitan ng iba't ibang proseso ng paglikha ng salita.
items.memoryTip: BALBAL = Slang / Kanto na salita (pinakamababang lebel ng wika).
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Antas ng Wika

items.question: Uri ng panghalip na ginagamit na panturo sa mga bagay.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Palagyo ay kaukulan ng panghalip panao.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Ang panghalip na pamatlig (demonstrative pronoun) ay ginagamit sa pagtuturo ng tao, bagay, o lugar (hal. ito, iyan, iyon).
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Panaklaw ay sumasaklaw sa kaisahan o dami.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Palayon ay kaukulan ng panghalip panao bilang layon.

items.explanation: Ang panghalip pamatlig (demonstrative pronoun) ay inihahalili sa pangngalang itinuturo (halimbawa: ito, nito, dito, iyan, niyan, diyan, iyon, niyon, doon).
items.memoryTip: Panturo sa bagay (ito, iyan, iyon) = PANGHALIP PAMATLIG.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Panghalip

items.question: Uri ng pagbabagong morponemiko na gumagamit ng pagpapalit ng posisyon ng ponema sa salita.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Asimilasyon ay pagbabago ng ponema dahil sa katabing tunog.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Paglalapi ay pagkakabit ng panlapi sa salitang-ugat.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Pagkaltas ay ang pagkawala ng isang ponema.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Ang metatesis ay ang pagbabagong morponemiko kung saan nagkakapalitan ng posisyon ang mga ponema sa loob ng salita (hal. tanim + -an = tamnan -> tanaman -> tamnan).

items.explanation: Ang metatesis ay ang pagpapalit ng posisyon ng mga ponema kapag ang salitang-ugat na nagsisimula sa /l/ o /y/ ay nilalagyan ng gitlaping -in- (halimbawa: -in- + luto = niluto).
items.memoryTip: METATESIS = Pagpapalit ng posisyon o lipat-tunog ng mga ponema sa salita.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Morpoponemiko

items.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang di-mahalagang salik sa pagtatalumpati?

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Okasyon ay mahalagang konteksto ng talumpati.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Paksa ay ang nilalaman ng talumpati.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Ang pagyayabang ay negatibong katangian at HINDI mahalagang salik sa mabisang pagtatalumpati.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Tagapakinig ang tumatanggap ng mensahe.

items.explanation: Ang mabisang pagtatalumpati ay nakasalalay sa mahusay na paksa, tamang pag-aangkop sa okasyon, at paggalang sa tagapakinig. Ang pagyayabang ay nakasisira sa komunikasyon.
items.memoryTip: Mahahalagang salik sa pagtatalumpati: Paksa, Okasyon, Tagapakinig. IWASAN ang Pagyayabang.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Pagtatalumpati

items.question: Ang pariralang nalaglag-nahulog ay nagpapakahulugan ng _______.

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. Ang 'nalaglag' at 'nahulog' ay dalawang salitang magkahawig o magkasingkahulugan ang ibig sabihin.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Magkapares ay tumutukoy sa dalawang bagay na laging magkasama.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Idyoma ay may talinghagang kahulugan.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Duplicate choice option.

items.explanation: Ang mga salitang nalaglag at nahulog ay may magkahawig o kasingkahulugang kahulugan na tumutukoy sa pagbaba o pagbagsak mula sa mataas na kinalalagyan.
items.memoryTip: Nalaglag - Nahulog = MAGKAHAWIG ang kahulugan (Synonyms).
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Kasingkahulugan
items.dataNote: Replaced duplicate choice D so all answer choices are unique.

items.question: Sa pangungusap na â€œMalakas ang boses mo.â€ Ang salitang malakas ay _______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Pangatnig ay nag-uugnay ng salita o sugnay.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Panghalip ay humahalili sa pangngalan.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Ang 'malakas' ay pang-uri (adjective) dahil inilalarawan nito ang pangngalang 'boses'.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Pandiwa ay nagsasaad ng kilos.

items.explanation: Ang pang-uri ay salitang naglalarawan sa katangian, dami, o anyo ng pangngalan o panghalip. Inilalarawan ng 'malakas' ang pangngalang 'boses'.
items.memoryTip: Naglalarawan sa pangngalan (boses) = PANG-URI.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Bahagi ng Pananalita

items.question: Anu ang salitang ugat ng PINAGLABANAN?

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. Ang salitang-ugat ng 'pinaglabanan' (pinag- + laban + -an) ay 'laban'.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Salitang may unlaping i-.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Salitang may hulaping -an.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Salitang may unlaping pag-.

items.explanation: Inaalis ang mga panlapi (pinag- at -an) sa salitang 'pinaglabanan' upang makuha ang pinakapayak na batayang salitang-ugat na 'laban'.
items.memoryTip: Pinaglabanan (pinag- + LABAN + -an) â†’ Salitang-ugat = LABAN.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Kayarian ng Salita

items.question: Ito ang rutang dinaraanan ng mensahe ng tagapagsalita.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Participant ay ang nagpapadala at tumatanggap ng mensahe.
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Ang tsanel (channel) ay ang daluyan o rutang dinaraanan ng mensahe mula sa tagapagsalita patungo sa tagapakinig.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Konteksto ay ang kalagayan o kapaligiran ng komunikasyon.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Pidbak ay ang ganting tugon ng tagapakinig.

items.explanation: Sa modelo ng komunikasyon, ang tsanel (channel) ang nagsisilbing daluyan o daanan ng mensahe (maaaring hininga/hangin sa pasalita, o papel/skrin sa pasulat).
items.memoryTip: Daluyan o daanan ng mensahe = TSANEL (Channel).
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Proseso ng Komunikasyon

items.question: Kalabang mortal ng pakikinig.

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. Ang ingay (noise) ang itinuturing na pangunahing kalaban o sagabal sa epektibong pakikinig.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Okasyon ay konteksto lamang.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Oras ay salik sa pagpaplano.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Salita ang mismong nilalaman ng mensahe.

items.explanation: Ang ingay sa kapaligiran o sa loob ng isip ang pinakamatinding sagabal sa konsentrasyon at tamang pagtanggap ng mga tunog sa pakikinig.
items.memoryTip: Kalabang mortal ng pakikinig = INGAY.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Pakikinig

items.question: Paraan ng pagbuo ng salita na ginagamitan ng tatlong uri ng panlapi.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Kabilaan ay dalawang panlapi (unahan at hulihan).
rationalization.choice_B: Correct. Ang laguhan ay ang paraan ng paglalapi kung saan may panlapi sa unahan, gitna, at hulihan ng salitang-ugat (hal. pag-sum-ikaw-an -> pagsumikapan).
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Inunlapian ay sa unahan lamang.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Hinulapian ay sa hulihan lamang.

items.explanation: Ang laguhan ay ang pinakamaituturing na kompletong uri ng paglalapi sapagkat nilalagyan ng panlapi ang unahan, gitna, at hulihan ng salitang-ugat (halimbawa: pag- + -in- + sikap + -an = pagsumikapan).
items.memoryTip: Tatlong uri ng panlapi (unahan, gitna, hulihan) = LAGUHAN.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Kayarian ng Salita

items.question: Isang uri ng pagmamatnubay kung saan ang mga reporter ay lumilihis sa pamatnubay; lumikha sila ng sariling paraan sa mga gawaing pag-ulat.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Kombensyunal ay sumusunod sa karaniwang baligtad na piramide (5 Ws & H).
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Masaklaw ay buod ng maraming datos.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Masining ay pangkalahatang paglalarawan.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Ang di-kombensyunal (novelty lead) na pamatnubay ay lumilihis sa karaniwang pamamaraan upang makabuo ng mas malikhain at natatanging pag-uulat.

items.explanation: Sa pahayagan, ang di-kombensyunal na pamatnubay (novelty lead) ay hindi gumagamit ng karaniwang pagsagot sa 5 Ws at H sa unang pangungusap. Sa halip, gumagamit ito ng kwento, dula, o paglalarawan upang makuha ang atensyon ng mambabasa.
items.memoryTip: Lumilihis sa karaniwang pamatnubay = DI-KOMBENSYUNAL (Novelty Lead).
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Journalism

items.question: Ang pagpapalitan ng mga ideya, opinyon, at salaysay sa pamamagitan ng mga sagisag ay tinatawag na ______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Pagtuklas ay paghahanap ng bagong kaalaman.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Pakikinig ay pagtanggap ng tunog.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Paglalahad ay pagpapaliwanag ng paksa.
rationalization.choice_D: Correct. Ang talastasan (komunikasyon) ay ang proseso ng pagpapalitan ng mga ideya, opinyon, at mensahe gamit ang mga simbolo o wika.

items.explanation: Ang talastasan ay interaktibong proseso ng pagpapalitan ng mensahe at ideya sa pagitan ng nagpapadala at tumatanggap gamit ang mga simbolo.
items.memoryTip: Pagpapalitan ng ideya at opinyon = TALASTASAN.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Komunikasyon

items.question: Uri ng pagsulat na ang pokus ay ang imahinasyon ng manunulat upang pukawin ang damdamin.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Jornalistik ay nakatuon sa balita at katotohanan.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Akademiko ay nakatuon sa pormal na pagsusuri at pamanahong papel.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Ang malikhaing pagsulat (creative writing) ay nakatuon sa imahinasyon ng may-akda upang pukawin ang damdamin at estetika ng mambabasa (hal. tula, maikling kwento).
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Teknikal ay nakatuon sa mga manwal at teknolohiya.

items.explanation: Ang malikhaing pagsulat ay naglalayong magpahayag ng kathang-isip, imahinasyon, at damdamin ng manunulat sa pamamagitan ng masining na paggamit ng wika.
items.memoryTip: Imahinasyon at pagpukaw ng damdamin = MALIKHAING PAGSULAT.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Uri ng Pagsulat

items.question: Piliin ang salitang walang diptonggo.

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. Ang 'musika' ay walang kumbinasyon ng patinig at malapatinag na /w/ o /y/ sa loob ng isang pantig, kaya WALA itong diptonggo.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. May diptonggong /ay/ sa pantig na 'hay'.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. May diptonggong /uy/ sa pantig na 'suy'.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. May diptonggong /iw/ sa pantig na 'siw'.

items.explanation: Ang diptonggo ay ang alinmang patinig (a, e, i, o, u) na sinusundan ng malapatinig na /w/ o /y/ sa loob ng isang pantig (hal. -aw, -ay, -ey, -iw, -iy, -oy, -uy). Ang salitang 'musika' (mu-si-ka) ay walang taglay na diptonggo.
items.memoryTip: Diptonggo = Patinig + W o Y sa isang pantig (ay, ey, iw, oy, uy). Musika = WALANG DIPTONGGO.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Fonolohiya

items.question: Nakapandidiri ang asong kalye na _______.

rationalization.choice_A: Incorrect. Dumihan ay pandiwa na nangangahulugang lagyan ng dumi.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Maling baybay na may gitling.
rationalization.choice_C: Correct. Ang 'madumi' ay ang angkop na pang-uri na naglalarawan sa maruming estado ng asong kalye.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Dumumi ay pandiwa na nangangahulugang nagbawas o nag-devisate.

items.explanation: Ang pang-uri na 'madumi' (marumi) ang wastong salitang naglalarawan sa katangian o pisikal na estado ng pangngalang 'asong kalye'.
items.memoryTip: Naglalarawan sa kalagayan ng aso = MADUMI (Pang-uri).
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Wastong Gamit ng Salita

items.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang mahalagang salik na dapat isaalang-alang sa pagtatalumpati?

rationalization.A: Correct. The audience should guide the content, language, and delivery of a speech.
rationalization.B: Incorrect. Pagyayabang is not a legitimate speech-planning factor.
rationalization.C: Incorrect. Insulting others is not a required speech factor.
rationalization.D: Incorrect. A speech should have a clear topic or purpose.

items.explanation: Ang tagapakinig ay mahalagang salik sa pagtatalumpati dahil dapat iangkop sa kanilang pangangailangan, kaalaman, at interes ang mensahe at paraan ng paglalahad.
items.memoryTip: MAHALAGANG SALIK SA TALUMPATI = TAGAPAKINIG.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Pagtatalumpati

items.question: Ang simbolong kumakatawan sa mga bagay at pangyayaring nais ipahayag ng tao sa kanyang kapwa ay ______.

rationalization.choice_A: Correct. Wika ang organisadong sistema ng mga arbitraryong simbolo na ginagamit ng tao sa pagpapahayag ng kaisipan at damdamin sa kapwa.
rationalization.choice_B: Incorrect. Sining ay pangkalahatang malikhaing ekspresyon.
rationalization.choice_C: Incorrect. Bokabularyo ay talaan lamang ng mga salita.
rationalization.choice_D: Incorrect. Tunog ay elemento lamang ng sinasalitang wika.

items.explanation: Ang wika ay ang pangunahing instrumento at sistema ng mga simbolo na ginagamit ng tao upang maipahayag ang kaniyang mga kaisipan, mithiin, at pangungusap sa kaniyang kapwa.
items.memoryTip: Sistema ng mga simbolo sa pakikipagtalastasan = WIKA.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Depinisyon ng Wika

items.question: Ang mga salitang teka, saan, tena, at dali ay nagtataglay ng anong pagbabagong morpoponemiko?

rationalization.A: Incorrect. Asimilasyon involves sound adjustment due to neighboring sounds.
rationalization.B: Incorrect. Metatesis involves exchanging the positions of sounds.
rationalization.C: Incorrect. Tono concerns pitch or intonation.
rationalization.D: Correct. The examples are commonly classified under pagkaltas (deletion/clipping of sound segments).

items.explanation: Ang mga halimbawang ito ay karaniwang ginagamit upang ilarawan ang pagkakaltas ng ponema o bahagi ng salita sa kolokyal na anyo.
items.memoryTip: TEKA, SAAN, TENA, DALI → PAGKALTAS.
items.reference: LET General Education Filipino Reviewer - Morpoponemiko
items.audit_reason: The source key A was incorrect. Standard LET reviewer versions of this item key D (Pagkaltas).
